retrieval.chunking: one sentence per chunk, stable filename and sentence order

refund_agent.resume_handling: pending cases require explicit approve/reject; rejected high-value request requires customer callback

limitations: The scenario CSV has no request timestamp; offline scenarios use the verified delivery timestamp as their request-time fixture. Live callers must provide a trusted request timestamp.
The mock agent fixture does not resolve a human escalation itself; escalation is persisted and resumed only with an explicit human decision.
